title: Ringtones
logline: Tuesday. The server's down and an email's up: $800 a month for a banner ad for ringtones. The strip draws the offer as a phone ringing with a song it won't name. Wood answers it. The strip cuts before he says yes.

panels.composition: The garage. The CRT: 509 Bandwidth Limit Exceeded, still. Beside it, a flip phone ringing on the table — the strip's device for the email. WOOD looking at it. BARNABY looking at it.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with saturated neon monitor glow cutting through a dark garage, jagged hyperactive linework, muddy digital flats, a dark garage with a CRT showing an error screen and a small flip phone ringing on the drafting table with music notes, a man and a small dog both staring at it

panels.composition: The phone's screen: $800 / MO · BANNER · RINGTONES. The notes coming off it, drawn as the stick figure's rotor lines.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with saturated neon monitor glow cutting through a dark garage, jagged hyperactive linework, muddy digital flats, close-up of a flip phone screen showing a short dollar offer with music notes drawn like helicopter rotor lines rising off it
image.notes: Letter after: $800 / MO · BANNER · RINGTONES. The notes are rotor strokes.

panels.composition: The eviction notice under the mug: $640. The phone: $800. Wood's eyes going from one to the other. The arithmetic drawn as a line between them.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with saturated neon monitor glow cutting through a dark garage, jagged hyperactive linework, muddy digital flats, a man's eyes moving between an eviction notice under a mug and a ringing phone with a thin drawn line connecting the two, no words

panels.composition: Wood's hand picking up the phone. Opening it. The strip cuts before his mouth opens. The dog's head down.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with saturated neon monitor glow cutting through a dark garage, jagged hyperactive linework, muddy digital flats, a man opening a flip phone in a dark garage with his mouth closed, a small dog lowering its head, no words
image.notes: The yes is never drawn. The banner appears Friday.

art.palette: limited; Sundays in watercolor, good now
art.paper: bristol; the browser; from 2008 coastal newsprint a week behind

notes: $640 under the mug, $800 on the phone. The yes not drawn.
